title: AI LinkedIn headshot generator, $29 for 40 photos

source.text: An AI headshot generator: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29. Launch country US, budget $2,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions.

problem: Professionals need a professional LinkedIn headshot without paying for a photo shoot
customer: US LinkedIn users (job seekers and professionals) who want a professional headshot
solution: Upload 10 selfies, an AI model generates 40 professional headshots
claims: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29
assumptions: Self-serve web app, no audience yet
Inference via a hosted API (fal.ai or similar), not own GPUs
Paid search or SEO as the main channel since none was stated
